lanes.summary: The diff exactly follows the acceptance criteria described in the ticket PMAT-1359. It updates `rustls` to 0.23.45 (which naturally pulls its `aws-lc` dependencies and `rustls-webpki` updates), bumps `chacha20` to 0.10.2, correctly marks the ghost roadmap rows PMAT-1354 and PMAT-1352 as completed, and introduces the required planned rows for PMAT-1358, PMAT-1356, and PMAT-1359 to successfully re-establish the CB-2115 issue/roadmap bijection. No unrequested changes or weakened gates were identified.

The diff for PMAT-1359 strictly fulfills all acceptance criteria and does nothing forbidden:
1. `Cargo.lock`: Upgrades rustls to 0.23.45 (clearing RUSTSEC-2026-0285) and chacha20 to 0.10.2 (clearing yanked crate). Transitive dependencies (aws-lc-rs, aws-lc-sys, rustls-webpki) are synchronized cleanly. Measured: `cargo deny check` passes with all advisories, bans, licenses, and sources ok.
2. `docs/roadmaps/roadmap.yaml`: Restores exact bijection between open roadmap items and open issues for CB-2115 (109 open items, 109 open issues) by marking closed issues PMAT-1354 and PMAT-1352 as completed, and adding entries for open issues #1358, #1359, and #1356. Measured: 109 open items confirmed, and `scripts/work-sync-control.sh` passes all 4 arms with 6,787 lines round-tripped byte-for-byte.
3. Gates & Scope: No gates were weakened, no code or test files were modified outside the ticket's scope, both branch commits carry valid `Pmat-Ticket: PMAT-1359` trailers, and `cargo check --workspace --all-targets` passes cleanly.
